answer: Here is a specific defense: force a unique proof-of-place stamp per epoch that cannot be replayed by siblings. Anomalous synchrony in submission timestamps is a hard tell. Because it works by converting a one-time spend into a recurring per-account bill, payouts to the cluster are redistributed to the honest peer pool. An identity earns only when its ivory recurs, its shale survives audit, and a thread from an unlinked peer confirms it.
